title: Assembly of sectionwise gluing into module-sheaf pullback
statement: Sectionwise amalgamation data for all test opens assembles to the categorical pullback of module sheaves.

source.place: Tags 01EB and 08BV, sheaf gluing on a two-open union

proof.text: Prove the private helper imageRestriction_comp by sheaf-morphism extensionality. At a test open, apply the injective direct-image comparison at W; the section-restriction formula reduces composition of transported restrictions to PresheafOfModules.map_comp_apply and uniqueness of inclusion morphisms. Apply this twice to get commutativity of the square.

For each test open use the supplied hypothesis h, rather than invoke the sectionwise-gluing theorem: existence gives surjectivity onto compatible pairs, and uniqueness identifies any two sections with equal images. Together with commutativity, Mathlib Types.isPullback_iff gives the pullback after forgetting modules to types. IsPullback.of_map_of_faithful reflects it to the category of modules.

PresheafOfModules.evaluationJointlyReflectsLimits assembles the evaluated pullback cones into a limiting cone of module presheaves; PullbackCone.isLimitMapConeEquiv identifies each evaluated cone with the corresponding pullback cone. Finally the fully faithful SheafOfModules.forget reflects the pullback to module sheaves. These are existing proved Mathlib limit-reflection results, so no intermediate existence or naturality theorem is left unproved.

proof_origin.note: Complete Lean proof using the proved section-restriction comparison and existing Mathlib sheaf gluing and limit-reflection theorems. No new holes.

lean.statement:
theorem schemeOpenUnionModuleImage_isPullback_of_sectionwise
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U V : X.Opens)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    (h : ∀ T : X.Opens,
      ∀ b : ((schemeOpenModuleImage X U).obj M).val.obj (.op T),
      ∀ c : ((schemeOpenModuleImage X V).obj M).val.obj (.op T),
      (((schemeOpenModuleImageRestriction X
        (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ≤ U))).app M).val.app (.op T) b =
        ((schemeOpenModuleImageRestriction X
          (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ≤ V))).app M).val.app (.op T) c) →
      ∃! a : ((schemeOpenModuleImage X (U ⊔ V)).obj M).val.obj (.op T),
        ((schemeOpenModuleImageRestriction X
          (homOfLE (le_sup_left : U ≤ U ⊔ V))).app M).val.app (.op T) a = b ∧
        ((schemeOpenModuleImageRestriction X
          (homOfLE (le_sup_right : V ≤ U ⊔ V))).app M).val.app (.op T) a = c) :
    IsPullback
      ((schemeOpenModuleImageRestriction X
        (homOfLE (le_sup_left : U ≤ U ⊔ V))).app M)
      ((schemeOpenModuleImageRestriction X
        (homOfLE (le_sup_right : V ≤ U ⊔ V))).app M)
      ((schemeOpenModuleImageRestriction X
        (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ≤ U))).app M)
      ((schemeOpenModuleImageRestriction X
        (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ≤ V))).app M)
